# Old URL Redirects - Do Not Edit Case Studies Here

This folder exists only to keep old `/portfolio-posts/...` URLs working.

Do not edit portfolio case-study content in this folder.

Edit published case studies here:

```text
portfolio/published/
```

Edit local draft case studies here:

```text
portfolio/drafts/
```

The `.html` files in this folder are redirect wrappers. They forward old links
to the organized published or draft locations.
